query:
Two members expressed the view that participants should read the game rules before arriving at a session. Which member made the more specific, procedural version of this argument — specifying how and when it should happen?

Options:
A. Tomasz
B. Derek
C. Marcus
D. Raj
context:
[1] (about=Marcus, core, t0 @2026-03-02T19:00:00) Supports sending rulebook link by Wednesday for new games to cut setup time.
[2] (about=GROUP, said_by=Marcus, group-insight, t0 @2026-03-02T19:00:00) Group agrees that for new games, the owner should send rulebook link by Wednesday to reduce setup time.
[3] (about=Nadia, core, t2 @2026-04-06T19:00:00) Agreed that house rules should be agreed up front as a pre-session variant declaration, not a violation of the rulebook.
[4] (about=Priya, episodic, t11 @2026-04-13T19:00:00) ok Soo-Yeon hosting again tonight 🎲 what's on the menu game-wise?
[5] (about=Tomasz, core, t0 @2026-03-02T19:00:00) Argues that game should be decided before the night so people can read rules; new members need shorter rules overhead first.
agent_answer: C. Marcus — he made the more specific, procedural argument: the rulebook link should be sent by Wednesday for new games, specifying both the method (sending the link) and the timing (by Wednesday). Tomasz also mentioned reading rules before the night, but less procedurally.
